flags.summary: Oct. 2026: The Lafayette Journal & Courier reported, citing a source, that Alting is accused of shoplifting from a Lafayette Walmart on Sept. 22 and a Monticello Walmart on Oct. 1; Elkhart County Prosecutor Vicki Becker was appointed special prosecutor to review possible charges, and no charges had been filed .
flags.note: Police reports; no charges filed as of Oct. 8, 2026. Includes his statement that he is stepping back from active campaigning. Previously shown in the public profile. The same Journal & Courier report says public records list his main residence in Monticello.
